Input.Content: The garden board calls the seed library its first practical expression of the neighbourhood-sharing plan. This is the board’s stated meaning, not a measured result. The library is a pilot; expansion is undecided. No visitor survey or sharing-outcome study has been conducted. Opening hours are not yet fixed.

Idea.Title: A sharing ambition takes a first practical form
Idea.Description: A sharing ambition takes a first practical form
Idea.Rationale: Preserve observed conclusions and their limits.
Idea.Evidence: The library has already increased neighbourhood sharing.
